description: Baseline the external-plugin Remote patch was exported against. A DSH upgrade moves the hunk (it already went from analyzer.ts:1850 to :1936 across 0.1.5-rc.1 -> rc.2), so the patch and this pin must be refreshed together.
targetNote: Both paths matter. The spec carries the regression test for this fix, including the negative case that an unrelated package with a protocol-shaped declaration must not be recognized. A re-export that named only the analyzer would silently drop it.
artifactNote: The patch adds a ts.resolveModuleName call for the protocol package. The source comment cannot be used here: the bundler strips comments, so only emitted code survives into lib/index.js, which is what actually runs.
